results.name: WebSocket failover live (WP-14, TT41 blocker): a fresh process reads a PAC file whose first entry is a DEAD proxy — ws:// is carried by the second entry (pproxy HTTP CONNECT) and wss:// by the second entry (pproxy SOCKS5, real TLS to the echo site verified against the test CA); the bridge proxied pages use gets OPEN with the negotiated subprotocol, 3 text messages (UTF-8) and 1 binary message echo byte-exact from an independent server (Python websockets), a clean 1000 close, one failover recorded per run, and the dead proxy received only the proxy handshake, never a WebSocket byte

SOCKS4a live (WP-14, TT41 blocker): https://pypi.org/ through an INDEPENDENT SOCKS4a server (asyncssh's forward_socks over a real SSH connection to an in-process asyncssh server): the bytes on the wire are a SOCKS4a CONNECT — VN 4, CD 1, port 443, DSTIP 0.0.0.x (x ≠ 0), userid, then the NAME "pypi.org" — and the SSH server was asked to dial "pypi.org" by name; control: SOCKS4 to the same server puts a public IPv4 address on the wire (resolved locally through the public-address guard) and the SSH server dials that address, never the name
